content: Jesu memikŋiye hekidi Jesu honene ugiŋ
Jesu adi ninadi kwanai tubudapmaaŋ mihiŋiye yanagila Kidolon ime meŋeŋa bem gimiŋ kwanai niŋ fokolok hatugukneŋ uŋoŋ ugiŋ.
Jesu adi mihiŋiyedut faŋgoŋ faŋgoŋ kwet uŋgoŋ bopneyagiŋ doktiŋa Judas Jesu mikme kohohik gineŋ kameŋdok adi maaŋ kwet u agaŋ nadiluguk.
Ala uŋgoŋ hatune Judas adi wooŋ mikme eŋ Falisi tiŋa talitimeŋ wapuhi heki’walaŋ kwanai-mehiye yanagila mik bomboŋ moŋgola kamaŋ gali bem tiŋa ugiŋ.
Jesu adi nemenemek timineŋ u agaŋ nadidapmaguk doktiŋa wo yeniŋguk, “Hidi nedigoŋ lohiiŋ?”
Yeninadiguk kaŋ niŋgiŋ, “Indi Jesu Nasaletniŋ lohiyam.” Yogiŋ kaŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu adikuyoŋ.” Nai uŋaniŋ Judas adi maaŋ noŋgoŋ uŋgoŋ yakiŋ.
Ala Jesudi, “Nu adikuyoŋ” yeniŋguk kaŋ hake sigisigi wooŋ kwetfoloŋ maaŋ hakiŋ.
Kaŋ Jesudi kotigoŋ yeninadiguk, “Hidi nedigoŋ lohiiŋ?” Yeniŋguk kaŋ niŋgiŋ, “Jesu Nasaletniŋ lohiyam.”
Yogiŋ kaŋ Jesudibo yeniŋguk, “Nu mede agaŋ haniŋat. Nu adikuyoŋ ale hidi nu nobu nolohiyaneŋ kaŋ me noli i biyabuneŋ.”
(Unduŋ tubune mede koom yoguk wondi folooŋ titiŋdok yo yoguk, “Baŋ, me namguŋ u nebek nemu filak.”)
Unduŋ ya yolu Saimon Pita adi miknoŋŋiŋ tamali tiŋa Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum’walaŋ tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ magi didimeniŋneŋkade filodiguk. Me u wou Malikus.
Kaŋ Jesudi Pita niŋguk, “Miknoŋ u koti yolineŋ dahiweŋ. Du nu Baŋdi folofigita nadiwit yoguk u kamehep-kube tibe tilaŋ.”
Jesu honeeŋ nagila Anas’walaŋ ugiŋ

Unduŋ tubune mikme heki eŋ talitimeŋhik eŋ Judame heki’walaŋ sigiyakadihiye adi Jesu honegiŋ. Honeeŋ ibidihiŋa Anas’walaŋ nagila ugiŋ. Nai uŋaniŋ Kaifa adi Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum hatiguk. Adi Anas’walaŋ waabiŋiŋ nagikuk.
Nai uŋaniŋ Kaifadi Judame heki’walaŋ me wapuhi indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Metam hogohogok indi kadaka-dapmaneemneŋ doktiŋa me kubugoŋ niŋdi kumuŋa nihitubu-lodawaak u kedem.”
Jesu honeeŋ nagila ulune mihiŋiyat lufomdi keletaugumuk
Saimon Pita dut Jesu mihiŋiŋ niŋ adi Jesu nagila ulune mindaŋ keletaugumuk. Ala Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum adi mihi niŋ u agaŋ nadimiluguk doktiŋa adi Jesu keleeŋ gimbahaŋ maaneŋ noŋgoŋ fogiŋ
kaŋ Pita adi fakaŋ uŋgoŋ woom hakuk. Wom hatu Jesu mihiŋiŋ niŋ adi kotigoŋ fooŋ waabi niŋ yeme kadoko tuguk u nimbune yeme dilitombune Pita maaŋ maaneŋ foguk.
Kaŋ yeme kadoko waabi wondi Pita kaŋ ninadiguk, “Me wondiniŋ mihiŋiŋ niŋ du kube?” Ninadiguk kaŋ Pitadibo yoguk, “Nu moŋ.”
Kwet sububa tuguk kaŋ tipilapilaye-metam eŋ mikme heki adi kudup heeŋ hekobu yakiŋ. Kaŋ Pita adi maaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ uŋgoŋ yali kudup hokom yatuguk.
Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapumdi Jesu ninadiguk
Jesu nagi logiŋ kaŋ Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapumdi
Jesu ninadiguk, “Mihigeye tiŋa metam mede dediŋ hinek yenindidimelaŋ?”
Kaŋ Jesudibo niŋguk, “Nu nemek kabup nemu yolugut, nu adi Siloŋyotneŋ be bopyotneŋ metam fee bopneyagiŋ kaŋ mede yenilugut.
Ale du maŋgoŋde nu naninadilaŋ? Tobo metam uŋak yeninadiweŋ kaŋ nu nemek yenimbe nadiyagiŋ u kedem ganineŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune mikme uŋoŋ yakiŋneniŋ niŋdi Jesu fawi foloŋ utawatukula niŋguk, “Du Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum mede undiniŋ maŋgoŋde nilaŋ?”
Unduŋ nimbune Jesudi indiŋ yoguk, “Nemek yobe kadakaŋak kaŋ mebi nanimbu nadiwit, eŋ nemek talii foloŋgoŋ nobu yobit kaŋ maŋgoŋde nutaŋ?”
Unduŋ yobune Anasdi Jesu kohoŋ folokenenit undiniŋgoŋ kameune Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum
Kaifa’walaŋ nagila ugiŋ.
Pitadi Jesu sigilulum timiŋguk
Jesu unduŋ timilune Pita adi yakukneŋ uŋgoŋ yali kudup-hokom yatuguk. Kaŋ me noŋgoŋ yakiŋdi niŋgiŋ, “Me wondiniŋ mihiŋiŋ niŋ du-ku be?” Niŋgiŋ kaŋ Pitadibo kamehebiŋa yeniŋguk, “Nu moŋ.”

Unduŋ yoluguk kaŋ Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum diniŋ tipilapilaye-me Pitadi magi udokoguk’walaŋ dikiŋiŋ niŋ adi noŋgoŋ yakiŋ, ala Pita kaŋ niŋguk, “Bem gimiŋ kwanai gineŋ dugoŋ bidak noŋgoŋ yaliŋiŋ kaŋ gabuŋat aŋ?”
Nimbu Pitadi yoguk, “Nu moŋ.” Yalaŋ kotigoŋ unduŋ ya yolune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ pupup kutiguk.
Jesu nagila Pailat’walaŋ ugiŋ

Helehautaune haniŋ Jesu Kaifa yolineŋ hakukneniŋ nagila Pailat’walaŋ ugiŋ. Pailat adi Lomahi’walaŋ me wapum. Kaŋ Judame heki’walaŋ me wapuhi adi Aŋelodi Yabukiyondaaŋ Yalakapmegukdok hinamuni tiŋa nanaŋdok nai doktiŋa walaniŋgoŋ hali nanim yoŋa maaneŋ mu fogiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa Pailatdi fakaŋ fooŋ yeninadiguk, “Hidi me i maŋgoŋ yom tiŋak kaŋ honeeŋ nagi buŋit?”
Unduŋ yeninadiguk kaŋ niŋgiŋ, “Indi me i kadakaniŋ titiŋ moŋ binek adi du’walaŋkade tuwot mu nagi bunetumun.”
Yogiŋ kaŋ Pailatdibo indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Unduŋ ale hidi hide nagi wooŋ Yodoko Medehik hatak undugoŋ keleeŋ nindapmaneŋ.” Yenimbune Judame hekidi yogiŋ, “Indi me niŋ nindapmane kumundok tuwot moŋ.”
(Unduŋ tigiŋ kaŋ Jesudi koom kumuŋ dediniŋ kumundok yoguk wendiniŋ foloŋ mintaguk.)
Unduŋ yobune Pailat adi kotigoŋ udaneeŋ wooŋ kwelineŋ yali Jesu nihamaneu buune niŋguk, “Judahi’walaŋ me mapme du-kube?”
Ninadiguk kaŋ yoguk, “Mede i da be nadiŋa bu nanilaŋ be me nolidi ganiŋit?”
Unduŋ yoguk kaŋ Pailatdibo tubu-udaneeŋ yoguk, “Be nu Judame nadilaŋ? Du yadi da metamgeye eŋ talitimeŋgeye nehigoŋ ganagila buŋa kohone foloŋ gapmeŋit. Maŋgoŋ tuguŋ kaŋ ganagi buŋa gapmeŋit?”

Ninadiune Jesudi yoguk, “Nu adi kwet yendiniŋ mapme moŋ, nu kwet yendiniŋ mapme hatilit binek adi mikmeneyedi Judame talitimeŋ heki nanagitne tiŋit undineŋ kibikibi mindobune tiŋit. Unduŋ doktiŋa nu adi kwet yendiniŋ mapme moŋ.”

Unduŋ yobune Pailatdi niŋguk, “Unduŋ yolaŋ ale yobeŋ. Du mapme iŋgoŋ be?” Yobune Jesudibo yoguk, “Da yolaŋ uŋakoŋ, nu adi mapme. Nu mede biyagoŋ yohautawene kwetfoloŋ fooŋ mintagut. Ale nebek niŋ adi mede biyagoŋ kamehatilak adi medene not timilak.”
Unduŋ yobu Pailatdi niŋguk, “Ka mede biyagoŋ u maŋgoŋ!” Unduŋ yoŋa fakaŋ fooŋ buŋa Judahi metam indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu me i kadakaniŋŋiŋ lohi tilat.”
Pailatdi Jesu bikabune uuŋdok yeninadiguk

“Tiŋa hide’walaŋ titiŋhik niŋ indiŋ hatak. Aŋelodi Yabukiyondaaŋ Yalakapmeguk diniŋ nai foloŋ gulet indigoŋ me niŋ yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ hogok yeniŋkulene wiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi dediŋ nadiiŋ. Judahi’walaŋ mapme i niŋkule fooŋ wek be nadiiŋ?”
Unduŋ yobune kutifiyeeŋ niŋgiŋ, “Moŋ, adi moŋ, adi Balabas bikabunimbeŋ.” (Balabas adi gapman dut mik tiŋa me niŋ ulukumuŋguk.)
